risks: GAP (not conflict) - pricing layer: 03_PRICING_PFU_VAT.md specifies configurable markup, minimum profit, PFU provenance, VAT configuration, deterministic rounding and immutable price snapshots. None exists yet. This is a documented target capability that has not been implemented, and is the work of a later phase.

GAP (not conflict) - supplier capability model: 01_SUPPLIER_ARCHITECTURE.md requires explicit supplier capabilities and a normalized observation carrying stock confidence, lead time, price_verified_at, stock_verified_at, source type and PFU. The suppliers table has no capability columns and supplier_listing_prices carries observed_at only. Target-state gap, to be closed in Phase 1.

GAP (not conflict) - Inter-Sprint integration state: supplier documentation supports bulk FTP catalogue feeds; production currently holds a single manual spreadsheet import (adapter 'isb', import_mode 'partial', committed 2026-09-08). Nothing in verified supplier documentation contradicts FTP capability, so this is an implementation-state gap, not a specification conflict.

GAP (not conflict) - no Inter-Sprint/Deldo adapter code exists; the reusable asset is the generic importer gorush_commit_catalogue_batch rather than a lane-specific adapter. 05_IMPLEMENTATION_PRIORITIES item 5 assumes more existing work than there is.

MILESTONE BLOCKER (data, not schema) - all 9,559 supplier_listing_prices rows have NULL purchase_price, NULL stock_exact and NULL stock_raw. The source spreadsheet carried no price or stock columns. The unified-search milestone needs real commercial data from at least one lane regardless of what is implemented.

PRODUCTION FRAGILITY (pre-existing, not introduced) - gorush_new_unit_token() is LANGUAGE sql and calls gen_random_bytes() unqualified while the function lives in the extensions schema. It resolves only when extensions is on the caller's search_path. The postgres role has it; anon/authenticated/authenticator do not. Reproduced on a local instance both failing and passing on search_path alone. NOT tested against production - that would be a production write. See docs/SCHEMA_BASELINE.md section 8.

MIGRATION LEDGER - the repository and production still disagree. client_offer_requests is recorded as 20260804000000 in the repository and 20260820124105 in production, and production holds 13 further migrations the repository does not. A blind supabase db push against production remains forbidden. Reconciliation is written up but not executed (docs/SCHEMA_BASELINE.md section 5.4).

REPOSITORY DRIFT - the repository's 20260804000000 migration and production's applied version of is_valid_tyre_request differ textually (semantically identical). Direct evidence the repository file diverged from what was applied. The baseline carries production's exact body per the precedence rule.

SUPPLIER MASTER DATA - the suppliers table contains test/junk records ('asdas', 'Name', 'Furnizor Demo (test)') and unmerged duplicates (ZUIN x4, FINTYRE x2, CARLINI x2). Attaching lanes and capabilities to this list unchanged would encode the mess.
No test runner exists. The only working gates are 'npx tsc --noEmit' and 'npm run build'. npm run lint is unusable - ESLint was never initialized.
Two parallel customer intakes (quote_requests, client_offer_requests) remain in place, unchanged, by owner instruction. Canonical intake is to be decided when the sales-order layer is designed.
decisions_required: NOT BLOCKING PHASE 1 - Migration ledger reconciliation (docs/SCHEMA_BASELINE.md section 5.4). Recommended: steps 1-3 only (backup, adopt 'production is baselined at 20260908142622', retire the superseded repository migration to an archive folder). That gives a trustworthy repository with ZERO production writes. Step 4, supabase migration repair, writes to production's ledger and needs its own separate approval. Needed before any future production migration, not before Phase 1 staging work.

BLOCKS CATALOGUE ATTRIBUTION, NOT PHASE 1 SCHEMA WORK - provenance of GommaRush_ISB_Tyre_Catalogue_Import-3.xlsx. 9,559 listings are attached to a supplier record named 'asdas'. Phase 1 can add supplier lanes, capabilities and observation columns without touching this data; reassigning those listings to a real lane cannot proceed until the file's origin is confirmed.

BLOCKS PHASE 3 (pricing) - PFU inside the VAT base. 03_PRICING_PFU_VAT.md puts PFU into taxable_subtotal. This matches common Italian treatment of the contributo ambientale PFU and the no-markup-on-PFU rule matches the legal pass-through requirement, but it is a tax position for the commercialista, not an engineering choice.

BLOCKS PHASE 3 (pricing) - rounding scope, per unit or per line. On 4 tyres at cost 80.00, 20% markup, PFU 2.60, VAT 22%: per-unit gives 481.16, per-line gives 481.17. Price snapshots are immutable, so this must be settled before the first snapshot is written.
